title: Aoristus Prīmus: Āctīvus et Medius
subtitle: Aoristus “prīmus” (sigmaticus, regulāris): λύω → ἔλυσα; sēnsus fundāmentālis aoristī (āctiō simplex, singulāris, sine referentiā ad continuitātem).
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē aoristum āctīvum et medium “prīmum” (sigmaticum) verbī λύω
Explicāre sēnsum aspectuālem aoristī: āctiō vīsa ut PŪNCTUM simplex, opposita imperfectō (āctiō continua)
Formāre īnfīnītīvum aoristī āctīvī (λῦσαι) et medium (λύσασθαι), notandō accentum speciālem īnfīnītīvī āctīvī
Distinguere augmentum + thema + σα (aoristus) ā augmentō + thema (imperfectum, sine σα)

content.intro: Praeteritum Graecum nōn est ūnum sōlum tempus (dīversē ā Latīnō, ubi perfectum servit ambōbus sēnsibus): imperfectum (Gradū III, āctiō continua) et aoristus (hodiē, āctiō simplex/pūnctuālis) sunt DUO tempora praeteritī distīncta, cum sēnsibus aspectuālibus dīversīs, nōn temporālibus. “Aoristus” (Graecē ἀόριστος, “illīmitātus/indefinitus”) significat āctiōnem vīsam ut ēventum simplicem, sine attentiōne ad ducātiōnem vel repetitiōnem.
content.explanation: Discrīmen aoristī ab imperfectō nōn est QUANDO āctiō facta est, sed QUŌMODO loquēns eam videt: ἔλυον (imperfectum) = “solvēbam” (continuē, per tempus); ἔλυσα (aoristus) = “solvī” (semel, ut ēventus simplex). Discrīmen aspectuāle, nōn temporāle stricte — comparā discrīmen imperfectō/perfectō simplicī Lūsitānicō (“eu soltava” vs. “eu soltei”).

rules.heading: a) Aoristus Āctīvus: ἔλυσα
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªἔλυσαἐλύσαμεν
2ªἔλυσαςἐλύσατε
3ªἔλυσε(ν)ἔλυσαν

Fōrmātiō: augmentum + thema + σα (signum aoristī “prīmī”) + dēsinentia. Compara cum imperfectō (ἔλυον, sine σα): differentia vīsibilis est praecīsē hoc σα īnsertum. Īnfīnītīvus: λῦσαι — nōtā accentum recessīvum speciālem in ultimā (paenultimā hīc, quia -αι fīnāle est “brevis” prō rēgulīs accentūs, exceptiō notābilis).

rules.heading: b) Aoristus Medius: ἐλυσάμην
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªἐλυσάμηνἐλυσάμεθα
2ªἐλύσωἐλύσασθε
3ªἐλύσατοἐλύσαντο

Nōtā ἐλύσω (2ª sg.): fōrma historica *ἐλύσασο contracta (σ intervōcālicum periit, ασο→ω) — patrōnus iam nōtus ex praesentī/futūrō mediō (Gradibus II/III). Īnfīnītīvus medius: λύσασθαι.

rules.heading: c) “Prīmus” vs. “Secundus”: Praevīsiō
rules.body: Hic aoristus vocātur “prīmus” (vel “sigmaticus”, “dēbilis”) quia adhibet σ ut signum characteristicum, applicābile ad maiōrem partem verbōrum. Multa verba frequentissima (praesertim brevia, thema monosyllabicum) adhibent in locō aoristum “secundum” (vel “fortem”), sine σ, cum thema ipsō mūtātō — patrōnus quem proximā lēctiōne vidēbis. Ambō genera significant idem aspectum (āctiō simplex); differunt sōlum morphologicē, nōn semanticē.

examples: ἔλυσα τὸν δοῦλον χθές. — Solvī servum herī. (āctiō simplex, ūnō mōmentō)
ἐλύσαμεν τὴν πόλιν ἐκ τῶν πολεμίων. — Līberāvimus urbem ab hostibus.
ἐλύσω σεαυτόν; — Līberāvistīne tē ipsum? (medium reflexīvum, 2ª sg.)
βουλόμεθα λῦσαι τὸν νόμον. — Volumus solvere/abrogāre lēgem. (īnfīnītīvus)
οἱ στρατιῶται ἔλυσαν τὰς πύλας. — Mīlitēs solvērunt portās.
τί ἐποίησας; — Quid fēcistī? (aoristus verbī contractī, augmentum + contractiō + σα)

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere sēnsum aoristī cum sēnsū imperfectī, crēdēns ambō significāre sōlum “praeteritum” sine discrīmine aspectūs.
commonMistakes.right: Distinguere: imperfectum = āctiō continua/repetīta; aoristus = āctiō simplex, vīsa ut pūnctum.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen aspectuāle est fundāmentāle prō intellēctū prōsae Graecae; error hīc distorquet sēnsum nārrātīvum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Omittere σ characteristicum, cōnfundendō aoristum āctīvum prīmum cum imperfectō (ἔλυον vs. ἔλυσα).
commonMistakes.right: Attendere σα (vel σ sōlum ante vōcālem) ut signum distīnctīvum morphologicum aoristī prīmī.
commonMistakes.why: Sine hōc signō, discipulus nōn potest distinguere tempora morphologicē, sōlum contextuāliter (minus fīdēle).

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre eundem sēnsum ad omne verbum cuius aoristus est “secundus” (sine σ), crēdēns eōs esse aspectuāliter dīversōs ab aoristō prīmō.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī aoristus prīmus et secundus sunt purē morphologicē dīversī; sēnsus aspectuālis (āctiō simplex) est identicus in ambōbus.
commonMistakes.why: Terminologia “prīmus/secundus” refert ad classem morphologicam, nōn ad differentiam significātiōnis.

exercises.title: Coniugā Aoristum Prīmum
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā aoristī prīmī.

items.prompt: Ἐγὼ τὸν δοῦλον ___ χθές. (1ª sg. aor. āctīvī, λύω)
Ὁ στρατηγὸς τὰς πύλας ___. (3ª sg. aor., “solvit”)
Ἡμεῖς ἑαυτοὺς ___. (1ª pl. aor. mediī, “līberāvimus nōs ipsōs”)

items.explanation: Aoristus vidēt āctiōnem ut ēventum simplex, sine attentiōne ad ducātiōnem.

items.prompt: Quod signum morphologicum distinguit aoristum prīmum ab imperfectō?
options: dēsinentia persōnālis dīversa in omnī fōrmā
items.explanation: Σα (vel σ sōlum) est signum distīnctīvum vīsibile aoristī prīmī.

items.prompt: Unde orītur fōrma ἐλύσω (2ª sg. aor. mediī)?
items.explanation: Σ intervōcālicum periit, ασο→ω, patrōnus iam nōtus.

items.prompt: Sunt aoristus prīmus et secundus dīversī semanticē (in sēnsū aspectuālī)?
options: nōn, sunt purē morphologicē dīversī; sēnsus est identicus

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma īnfīnītīvī aoristī mediī verbī λύω?

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Aoristus et imperfectum differunt praecipuē in aspectū (continuitāte vs. simplicitāte āctiōnis), nōn sōlum in tempore chronologicō.
Aoristus prīmus adhibet σ ut signum morphologicum, quod imperfectum nōn habet.
Aoristus, sīcut futūrum, numquam accipit augmentum.
items.explanation: Falsum: aoristus EST tempus praeteritum indicātīvum, ergō requīrit augmentum (dīversē ā futūrō).

items.statement: Terminologia “aoristus prīmus/secundus” refert ad discrīmen semanticum (sēnsūs dīversī).
items.explanation: Falsum: refert ad classem morphologicam; sēnsus aspectuālis est identicus.

summary: Aoristus āctīvus λύω: ἔλυσα, ἔλυσας, ἔλυσε(ν) // ἐλύσαμεν, ἐλύσατε, ἔλυσαν. Īnfīnītīvus: λῦσαι.
Aoristus medius: ἐλυσάμην, ἐλύσω, ἐλύσατο // ἐλυσάμεθα, ἐλύσασθε, ἐλύσαντο. Īnfīnītīvus: λύσασθαι.
Aoristus vidēt āctiōnem ut PŪNCTUM simplex (aspectus), opposita imperfectō (āctiō continua) — discrīmen aspectuāle, nōn tantum temporāle.
Aoristus “prīmus” (sigmaticus, σα) est patrōnus regulāris; aoristus “secundus” (proxima lēctiō) est alius patrōnus morphologicus prō eōdem aspectū.
